# The dialog example opens on an app scene

## Context

The dialog is the first card of Dialogs & Overlays. #21140's target renews it as "an app scene", and #21439 delivered three parts of that row: a cover, the focus that returns to the button on Escape, and the wrap at 390 px. The scene itself was not built, and a row-by-row sweep of the target on 22 Nov found no leaf for it.

## The Problem

On `dev` `78013b10fc` `examples/dialog/MainContainer.mjs` is a block of text, a "Create Dialog" button and a theme button, and the dialog it opens is titled "Dialog 1". A visitor sees a test page: nothing gives the dialog a reason to exist, so its drag, its maximise and its modal state have nothing to show against.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/dialog/MainContainer.mjs` and `DemoDialog.mjs`; the record is a card in family `dialogs`, cross-listed in Drag & Drop.
- A cover is the frame a visitor lands on (#21140), so what the cover should show has to be on the first frame.

## The Fix

Rebuild the example in place as a small scene: a list of records (contacts, invoices, bookings: the builder's pick) and a dialog that edits the selected one. It opens with that dialog already open over the list, so the first frame is the point. The page offers what a buyer asks of a dialog: drag it, resize or maximise it, open a second one, modal against non-modal. One line says what to try. Escape still returns focus to the control that opened the dialog.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The first frame shows the scene with one dialog open, its fields filled from the selected record.
- [ ] Save writes back to the list; Cancel and Escape do not, and focus returns to the opener.
- [ ] Drag, maximise and a second dialog work by pointer; open, close and field navigation work by keyboard.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844, in every theme the example offers.
- [ ] The record's name and caption are in the visitor's words, and the cover is retaken from the first frame at 960 × 540 (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: the first frame at both sizes and one frame mid-drag, Neo Dark, on the pull request.

## Out of Scope

Changes to `src/dialog`. The cross-window dialog (its own example and leaf).
